_comment: Pinned known-good program for the hero query 'Does #10 score the first goal?'. Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json. Serves two roles: (1) the golden target the Azure OpenAI codegen should reproduce, (2) the D-DR6 silent fallback if live codegen emits an invalid/non-whitelisted program. The named-binding chain frames->people->jerseys->numbers->tens->ordered->result is the load-bearing detect->crop->read_text association. Window 3500-5000ms covers the locked clip's goal moment (~4.0s) and the legible #10 scorer frame (~4.6s).
